name: Valcalepio

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Chardonnay, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Lombardy appellation of fifty-one communes, with wine and wine from raisined grapes made from six allowed grapes: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Moscato di Scanzo, Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco and Pinot Grigio.
